# Helen Palacios

> Marketing & Digital Strategy Lead specializing in growth, branding, and e-commerce for B2B and B2C brands. 7+ years of experience across consumer tech, FMCG, and Fortune 500 industrial sectors. Available for remote roles in US and EMEA time zones.

## About

Helen Palacios is a Marketing & Digital Strategy Lead based in Guatemala City, Guatemala. She builds desirable, trustworthy, and high-performing digital brands by combining strategy, creativity, technology, and corporate communication.

## Core capabilities

- Growth & Demand Generation (B2B and B2C funnels, lead capture, conversion optimization, A/B testing)
- Branding & Positioning (multi-brand rebranding, brand guidelines, visual identity, storytelling)
- SEO & AI-Driven Visibility (organic search, technical SEO, content matrices, GEO/LLM-search optimization)
- Paid Media & Performance (Google Ads, Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, ROAS optimization)
- Content & Editorial Strategy (editorial calendars, channel-audience segmentation, content pillars)
- Corporate Communication (reputation management, internal/external messaging, crisis comms)

## Experience highlights

- **Tecnolite** — Marketing, Digital & Branding Lead. Consumer tech / lighting. Strategic management of multi-brand portfolio with focus on e-commerce, content, paid media, and Marketing-Sales alignment.
- **Vitali Alimentos / Grupo AG** — Corporate Communication Specialist. FMCG / food industry. Led institutional communication and reputation-focused brand narrative.
- **3M Latin America** — In-House Designer / Marketing Assistant. B2B industrial / Fortune 500. Regional creative support for LATAM B2B campaigns.
